newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 3,500/T June MTBE at $267/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 3,500/T June MTBE at $267/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought through a tender 3,500 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) at around $267 per tonne, a company official said on Wednesday.
Traders said the award price at between $8-13 per tonne below the previous purchase was a clear reflection of the weak MTBE market.
Benchmark Singapore, MTBE prices have in April fallen by about $5-10 in April to $255/$265 per tonne, free-on-board.
The tender was awarded on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Kaohsiung and Keelung basis for delivery on June 10-24.
MTBE is an environmentally friendly gasoline octane enhancer.
In its last MTBE tender, CPC bought 3,500-tonnes for May 6-20 delivery at between $275 to $280 per tonne.
